front.title: Cedulon Checkpoints: Epoch Witnesses and Transparency

abstract.t: This document specifies epoch checkpoints, the transparency witness and the anchoring of checkpoints as SCITT Signed Statements for the Cedulon audit layer. The spend receipt, rail-extract reconciliation and trust-root rules live in the companion Cedulon Core document. A verifier that pins a witness key can detect a withheld or rolled-back checkpoint; without that pin the suppression guarantee is conditional.
